https://schemas.stacspec.org/v1.1.0/item.title: STAC Item
https://schemas.stacspec.org/v1.1.0/item.description: This object represents the metadata for an item in a SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog.

collection.title: Collection ID
collection.description: The ID of the STAC Collection this Item references to.

allOf.$comment: The if-then-else below checks whether the bands field is given in assets or not. If not, allows bands in properties (then), otherwise, disallows bands in properties (else).

if.$comment: If there is no asset with bands...

then.$comment: ... then bands are not allowed in properties...

else.$comment: ... otherwise bands are allowed in properties.

allOf.$comment: Link with relationship `self` must be absolute URI

https://schemas.stacspec.org/v1.1.0/item.title: STAC Common Metadata
https://schemas.stacspec.org/v1.1.0/item.description: This schema includes all common metadata fields.

title.title: Title
title.description: A human-readable title describing the entity.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to fully explain the entity.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: List of keywords describing the entity.

datetime.title: Date and Time
datetime.description: The searchable date/time of the data, in UTC (Formatted in RFC 3339)

start_datetime.title: Start Date and Time
start_datetime.description: The searchable start date/time of the data, in UTC (Formatted in RFC 3339)

end_datetime.title: End Date and Time
end_datetime.description: The searchable end date/time of the data, in UTC (Formatted in RFC 3339)

minimum.title: Minimum value of all the data values

maximum.title: Maximum value of all the data values

mean.title: Mean value of all the data values

stddev.title: Standard deviation value of all the data values

count.title: Total number of all data values

unit.title: Unit denomination of the data value
